query: WITH changed AS (UPDATE folioharbor.background_jobs SET state=$4,next_run_at=COALESCE($5,next_run_at),lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,error_code=$6,error_summary=$7,updated_at=$3 WHERE job_id=$1 AND state='leased' AND lease_owner=$2 AND lease_expires_at>$3 RETURNING attempt_count) UPDATE folioharbor.job_attempts a SET finished_at=$3,outcome=$8,error_code=$6,error_summary=$7 FROM changed c WHERE a.job_id=$1 AND a.attempt=c.attempt_count
